def parse_varint(data, pos):
    val = 0
    shift = 0
    while True:
        if pos >= len(data):
            raise ValueError("varint truncated")
        b = data[pos]
        val |= (b & 0x7F) << shift
        pos += 1
        if (b & 0x80) == 0:
            break
        shift += 7
    return val, pos

def parse_xz_file(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    file_size = len(data)
    offset = 0
    streams = []
    total_uncomp = 0
    total_stream_padding = 0
    footers = []
    for i in range(len(data)-11):
        if data[i+10] == 0x59 and data[i+11] == 0x5A:
            try:
                bsize = struct.unpack('<I', data[i+4:i+8])[0]
                real = (bsize+1)*4
                idx_start = i - real
                if idx_start >= 0 and idx_start < len(data) and data[idx_start] == 0:
                    footers.append((i, idx_start, real))
            except:
                continue
    footers.sort()
    while offset < len(data):
        pad_start = offset
        while offset + 4 <= len(data) and data[offset:offset+4] == b'\x00\x00\x00\x00':
            offset += 4
        if offset != pad_start:
            total_stream_padding += offset - pad_start
            if offset >= len(data):
                break
        if offset + 6 > len(data):
            remaining = data[offset:]
            if len(remaining) == 0:
                break
            if all(b == 0 for b in remaining):
                total_stream_padding += len(remaining)
                break
            raise ValueError("truncated")
        if data[offset:offset+6] != b'\xfd7zXZ\x00':
            raise ValueError("File format not recognized")
        header = data[offset:offset+12]
        check_type_id = header[7] & 0x0F
        check_size_map = {0:0, 1:4, 4:8, 10:32}
        check_size = check_size_map.get(check_type_id, 0)
        check_name_map = {0:"None", 1:"CRC32", 4:"CRC64", 10:"SHA256"}
        check_name = check_name_map.get(check_type_id, f"Unknown-{check_type_id}")
        candidate = None
        for f_start, idx_start, real in footers:
            if f_start > offset and idx_start >= offset+12:
                candidate = (f_start, idx_start, real)
                break
        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError("File format not recognized")
        f_start, idx_start, backward_real = candidate
        pos = idx_start
        if data[pos] != 0:
            raise ValueError("index indicator")
        pos += 1
        num_records, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
        records = []
        for _ in range(num_records):
            unpadded, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
            uncomp, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
            records.append((unpadded, uncomp))
        idx_data_len = pos - idx_start
        pad_len = (4 - ((idx_data_len + 4) % 4)) % 4
        pos += pad_len + 4
        blocks = []
        block_offset = offset + 12
        uncomp_offset_stream = 0
        for unpadded, uncomp in records:
            if block_offset + 1 > len(data):
                raise ValueError("block truncated")
            hdr_size_enc = data[block_offset]
            hdr_size = (hdr_size_enc + 1) * 4
            if block_offset + hdr_size > len(data):
                raise ValueError("block header overflow")
            bh = data[block_offset:block_offset+hdr_size]
            bflags = bh[1]
            has_comp = (bflags & 0x40) != 0
            has_uncomp = (bflags & 0x80) != 0
            p = 2
            comp_size = None
            if has_comp:
                comp_size, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
            if has_uncomp:
                _, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
            num_filters = (bflags & 0x03) + 1
            filter_descs = []
            for _ in range(num_filters):
                if p >= len(bh):
                    break
                fid, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
                fsize, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
                fprops = bh[p:p+fsize] if fsize>0 else b''
                p += fsize
                if fid == 0x21:
                    if fsize == 1 and fprops:
                        bits = fprops[0] & 0x3F
                        mant = 2 if bits%2==0 else 3
                        exp = 11 + bits//2
                        size = mant * (1 << exp)
                        if size >= 1024*1024:
                            ds = f"{size//(1024*1024)}MiB" if size%(1024*1024)==0 else f"{size}B"
                        elif size >= 1024:
                            ds = f"{size//1024}KiB"
                        else:
                            ds = f"{size}B"
                        filter_descs.append(f"--lzma2=dict={ds}")
                    else:
                        filter_descs.append("--lzma2=dict=8MiB")
                else:
                    filter_descs.append("--lzma2=dict=8MiB")
            if comp_size is None:
                comp_size = unpadded - hdr_size - check_size
            padded_comp = (comp_size + 3) & ~3
            total_block_size = hdr_size + padded_comp + check_size
            flags_str = ""
            if has_comp:
                flags_str += "c"
            if has_uncomp:
                flags_str += "u"
            if flags_str == "":
                flags_str = "--"
            comp_data_offset = block_offset + hdr_size
            check_offset = comp_data_offset + padded_comp
            check_val = data[check_offset:check_offset+check_size]
            # For display, reverse bytes for little-endian check
            if check_size in (4,8):
                check_val_display = check_val[::-1].hex()
            else:
                check_val_display = check_val.hex()
            blocks.append({
                'header_size': hdr_size,
                'comp_size': comp_size,
                'unpadded': unpadded,
                'uncomp': uncomp,
                'total_size': total_block_size,
                'comp_offset': block_offset,
                'uncomp_offset': uncomp_offset_stream,
                'check_val': check_val,
                'check_val_hex': check_val_display,
                'filter_str': ",".join(filter_descs) if filter_descs else "--lzma2=dict=8MiB",
                'flags_str': flags_str,
                'mem_usage': 9,
            })
            uncomp_offset_stream += uncomp
            block_offset += total_block_size
        comp_size_stream = f_start + 12 - offset
        uncomp_size_stream = sum(r[1] for r in records)
        streams.append({
            'blocks': blocks,
            'comp_offset': offset,
            'uncomp_offset': total_uncomp,
            'comp_size': comp_size_stream,
            'uncomp_size': uncomp_size_stream,
            'check_type': check_type_id,
            'check_name': check_name,
            'check_size': check_size,
            'index_offset': idx_start,
            'footer_offset': f_start,
        })
        total_uncomp += uncomp_size_stream
        offset = f_start + 12
    return {
        'streams': streams,
        'file_size': file_size,
        'total_blocks': sum(len(s['blocks']) for s in streams),
        'total_streams': len(streams),
        'total_uncomp': total_uncomp,
        'total_stream_padding': total_stream_padding,
        'check_name': streams[0]['check_name'] if streams else "None",
    }

def format_size_l(size):
    if size < 10*1024:
        return f"{size} B"
    if size < 1024*1024:
        return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
    if size < 1024*1024*1024:
        return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
    return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def format_ratio(comp, uncomp):
    if uncomp == 0:
        return "---"
    r = comp / uncomp
    if r > 9.999:
        return "---"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def format_ratio_verbose(comp, uncomp):
    if uncomp == 0:
        return "---"
    r = comp / uncomp
    if r > 9.999:
        return "> 9.999"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def parse_size_str(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if s.endswith('%'):
        return s
    for suf, mult in [("GiB",1024**3), ("MiB",1024**2), ("KiB",1024)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num = float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    for suf, mult in [("G",10**9), ("M",10**6), ("K",10**3)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num = float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    try:
        return int(s)
    except:
        return s

def get_default_settings():
    prog = os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]).lower()
    prog_full = sys.argv[0]
    default_op = "compress"
    default_stdout = False
    default_format = "xz"
    # Need to handle exact names
    base = os.path.basename(prog_full)
    lower_base = base.lower()
    if lower_base == "xzcat" or lower_base.endswith("xzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "auto"
    elif lower_base == "unxz" or lower_base.endswith("unxz"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "auto"
    elif lower_base == "lzcat" or lower_base.endswith("lzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif lower_base == "unlzma" or lower_base.endswith("unlzma"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif lower_base == "lzma" or lower_base.endswith("lzma"):
        # lzma compress, unless already handled unlzma/lzcat
        if "un" not in lower_base and "cat" not in lower_base:
            default_op = "compress"
            default_format = "lzma"
        else:
            default_op = "decompress"
            default_format = "lzma"
    else:
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "xz"
    return default_op, default_stdout, default_format

def main():
    prog = sys.argv[0]
    prog_basename = os.path.basename(prog)
    # For help display, use prog as given (argv[0]) to match original behavior which prints whatever path was used
    prog_for_help = prog
    default_op, default_stdout, default_format = get_default_settings()
    env_opts = []
    for env_var in ["XZ_DEFAULTS", "XZ_OPT"]:
        val = os.environ.get(env_var)
        if val:
            try:
                env_opts.extend(shlex.split(val))
            except:
                env_opts.extend(val.split())
    raw_args = env_opts + sys.argv[1:]

    operation = None
    keep = False
    force = False
    stdout_flag = default_stdout
    suffix_opt = None
    format_opt = None
    check_opt = "crc64"
    preset = 6
    extreme = False
    threads = None
    quiet = 0
    verbose = 0
    no_warn = False
    robot = False
    single_stream = False
    custom_filters = {}
    bcj_filters = []
    delta_options = None
    files = []
    files_from = []

    i = 0
    end_of_options = False
    while i < len(raw_args):
        arg = raw_args[i]
        if end_of_options:
            files.append(arg)
            i+=1
            continue
        if arg == "--":
            end_of_options = True
            i+=1
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--"):
            if "=" in arg:
                key, val = arg.split("=",1)
            else:
                key, val = arg, None
            if key == "--compress":
                operation = "compress"
            elif key == "--decompress":
                operation = "decompress"
            elif key == "--test":
                operation = "test"
            elif key == "--list":
                operation = "list"
            elif key == "--keep":
                keep = True
            elif key == "--force":
                force = True
            elif key in ("--stdout","--to-stdout"):
                stdout_flag = True
            elif key in ("--no-sync","--no-sparse"):
                pass
            elif key == "--single-stream":
                single_stream = True
            elif key == "--suffix":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    suffix_opt = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else None
                else:
                    suffix_opt = val
            elif key.startswith("--suffix="):
                suffix_opt = val
            elif key == "--files":
                if val is None:
                    files_from.append((None, False))
                else:
                    files_from.append((val, False))
            elif key.startswith("--files="):
                files_from.append((val, False))
            elif key == "--files0":
                if val is None:
                    files_from.append((None, True))
                else:
                    files_from.append((val, True))
            elif key.startswith("--files0="):
                files_from.append((val, True))
            elif key == "--format":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    format_opt = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else None
                else:
                    format_opt = val
            elif key.startswith("--format="):
                format_opt = val
            elif key == "--check":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    check_opt = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else "crc64"
                else:
                    check_opt = val
            elif key.startswith("--check="):
                check_opt = val
            elif key == "--ignore-check":
                pass
            elif key == "--threads":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    threads = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else None
                else:
                    threads = val
            elif key.startswith("--threads="):
                threads = val
            elif key.startswith("--block-size"):
                pass
            elif key.startswith("--block-list"):
                pass
            elif key.startswith("--flush-timeout"):
                pass
            elif key.startswith("--memlimit"):
                pass
            elif key == "--no-adjust":
                pass
            elif key == "--filters":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    custom_filters["filters"] = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else ""
                else:
                    custom_filters["filters"] = val
            elif key.startswith("--filters="):
                custom_filters["filters"] = val
            elif key.startswith("--filters") and key[9:].isdigit():
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    custom_filters[key[2:]] = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else ""
                else:
                    custom_filters[key[2:]] = val
            elif key == "--filters-help":
                sys.stdout.write(FILTERS_HELP_TEXT)
                sys.exit(0)
            elif key.startswith("--lzma1"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                custom_filters["lzma1"] = opt
            elif key.startswith("--lzma2"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                custom_filters["lzma2"] = opt
            elif key.startswith("--x86"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("x86", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--armthumb"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("armthumb", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--arm64"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("arm64", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--arm"):
                if key == "--arm" or key.startswith("--arm="):
                    opt = val if val is not None else ""
                    bcj_filters.append(("arm", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--powerpc"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("powerpc", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--ia64"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("ia64", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--sparc"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("sparc", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--riscv"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("riscv", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--delta"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                delta_options = opt
            elif key == "--quiet":
                quiet += 1
            elif key == "--verbose":
                verbose += 1
            elif key == "--no-warn":
                no_warn = True
            elif key == "--robot":
                robot = True
            elif key == "--info-memory":
                sys.stdout.write(INFO_MEMORY_TEXT)

            elif key == "--help":
                sys.stdout.write(short_help(prog_for_help))

            elif key == "--long-help":

            elif key == "--version":

            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: unrecognized option '{key}'\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"Try '{prog_basename} --help' for more information.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            i+=1
            continue
        if arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            import re
            m = re.match(r'^-([0-9])(e)?(.*)$', arg)
            if m:
                preset = int(m.group(1))
                if m.group(2):
                    extreme = True
                rest = m.group(3)
                for ch in rest:
                    if ch == 'e':
                        extreme = True
                    elif ch == 'k':
                        keep = True
                    elif ch == 'f':
                        force = True
                    elif ch == 'c':
                        stdout_flag = True
                    elif ch == 'q':
                        quiet +=1
                    elif ch == 'v':
                        verbose +=1
                    elif ch == 'Q':
                        no_warn = True
                    elif ch == 'z':
                        operation = "compress"
                    elif ch == 'd':
                        operation = "decompress"
                    elif ch == 't':
                        operation = "test"
                    elif ch == 'l':
                        operation = "list"
                    else:

                i+=1

            j = 1

                    sys.exit(0)
                elif ch == 'V':
                    sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT)
                    sys.exit(0)
                elif ch == 'e':
                    extreme = True
                elif ch in ('T','S','F','C','M'):
                    remaining = arg[j+1:]
                    if remaining:
                        val = remaining
                        j = len(arg)
                        if ch == 'T':
                            threads = val
                        elif ch == 'S':
                            suffix_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'F':
                            format_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'C':
                            check_opt = val
                        break
                    else:
                        i+=1
                        if i >= len(raw_args):
                            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: option requires an argument -- '{ch}'\n")
                            sys.exit(1)
                        val = raw_args[i]

                        elif ch == 'S':
                            suffix_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'F':
                            format_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'C':

                else:

                    sys.stderr.write(f"Try '{prog_basename} --help' for more information.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                j+=1
            i+=1

    def get_known_suffixes_for_compress(fmt):
        if suffix_opt is not None:
            if fmt == "xz":
                return [suffix_opt, ".xz", ".txz"]
            elif fmt == "lzma":
                return [suffix_opt, ".lzma", ".tlz"]
            else:
                return [suffix_opt]
        else:
            if fmt == "xz":
                return [".xz", ".txz"]
            elif fmt == "lzma":
                return [".lzma", ".tlz"]
            else:
                return [".xz", ".txz"]

    def get_known_suffixes_for_decompress():
        base = [".xz", ".txz", ".lzma", ".tlz"]
        if suffix_opt is not None:
            return [suffix_opt] + base
        return base

    def check_already_has_suffix(filename, fmt):
        known = get_known_suffixes_for_compress(fmt)
        for suf in known:
            if filename.endswith(suf):
                return suf
        return None

    def strip_suffix_for_decompress(filename):
        known = get_known_suffixes_for_decompress()
        for suf in known:
            if filename.endswith(suf):
                if suf in (".txz", ".tlz"):
                    prefix = filename[:-len(suf)]
                    return prefix + ".tar", suf
                else:
                    return filename[:-len(suf)], suf
        return None, None

    def get_check_const(s):
        s = s.lower()
        if s == "none":
            return lzma.CHECK_NONE
        if s == "crc32":
            return lzma.CHECK_CRC32
        if s == "crc64":
            return lzma.CHECK_CRC64
        if s == "sha256":
            return lzma.CHECK_SHA256
        return lzma.CHECK_CRC64

    def parse_filter_opts(opt_str):
        opts = {}
        if not opt_str:
            return opts
        parts = opt_str.split(',')
        for part in parts:
            part=part.strip()
            if not part:
                continue
            if "=" in part:
                k,v = part.split("=",1)
                opts[k.strip()] = v.strip()
            else:
                opts[part] = True
        return opts

                "ia64": lzma.FILTER_IA64,

            if bname in id_map:
                fid = id_map[bname]
                fd = {"id": fid}
                if bname == "delta":

                        try:
                            fd["dist"] = int(bopts["dist"])

                            pass
                else:
                    if "start" in bopts:

                        except:
                            pass
                chain.append(fd)
        if delta_options is not None:
            dopts = parse_filter_opts(delta_options)
            fd = {"id": lzma.FILTER_DELTA}
            if "dist" in dopts:
                try:
                    fd["dist"] = int(dopts["dist"])
                except:
                    pass
            chain.append(fd)

        use_lzma1 = False

            else:

        if format_opt == "xz" and use_lzma1:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: LZMA1 cannot be used with the .xz format\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        if format_opt == "lzma" and not use_lzma1:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: The .lzma format supports only the LZMA1 filter\n")
            sys.exit(1)

        lopts = parse_filter_opts(lzma_opt_str) if lzma_opt_str else {}

        if "preset" in lopts:
            pv = lopts["preset"]
            if isinstance(pv, str) and pv.endswith('e'):

                    lz_extreme = True
                except:
                    pass
            else:
                try:
                    lz_preset = int(pv)
                except:
                    pass

        fd = {"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA1 if use_lzma1 else lzma.FILTER_LZMA2}
        pv = lz_preset | (lzma.PRESET_EXTREME if lz_extreme else 0)
        fd["preset"] = pv
        if "dict" in lopts:
            try:
                sz = parse_size_str(lopts["dict"])

                pass
        if "lc" in lopts:

            except:
                pass
        if "lp" in lopts:
            try:
                fd["lp"] = int(lopts["lp"])
            except:
                pass
        if "pb" in lopts:
            try:
                fd["pb"] = int(lopts["pb"])
            except:
                pass
        if "mode" in lopts:
            if lopts["mode"] == "fast":

            elif lopts["mode"] == "normal":
                fd["mode"] = lzma.MODE_NORMAL
        if "nice" in lopts:

        if "mf" in lopts:

        if "depth" in lopts:
            try:
                fd["depth"] = int(lopts["depth"])
            except:
                pass
        chain.append(fd)

def parse_varint(data, pos):
    val = 0
    while True:
        if pos >= len(data):
            raise ValueError("varint truncated")
        b = data[pos]
        val |= (b & 0x7F) << ( (pos - (pos//1)) *0 + 0)  # dummy to avoid shift tracking, we will use shift variable correctly below
        # Actually we need shift tracking; redo with shift
        break
    # Correct implementation
    val = 0
    shift = 0
    while True:
        if pos >= len(data):
            raise ValueError("varint truncated")
        b = data[pos]
        val |= (b & 0x7F) << shift
        pos += 1
        if (b & 0x80) == 0:
            break
        shift += 7
    return val, pos

def parse_xz_file(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    file_size = len(data)
    offset = 0
    streams = []
    total_uncomp = 0
    total_stream_padding = 0
    footers = []
    for i in range(len(data)-11):
        if data[i+10] == 0x59 and data[i+11] == 0x5A:
            try:
                bsize = struct.unpack('<I', data[i+4:i+8])[0]
                real = (bsize+1)*4
                idx_start = i - real
                if idx_start >= 0 and idx_start < len(data) and data[idx_start] == 0:
                    footers.append((i, idx_start, real))
            except:
                continue
    footers.sort()
    while offset < len(data):
        pad_start = offset
        while offset + 4 <= len(data) and data[offset:offset+4] == b'\x00\x00\x00\x00':
            offset += 4
        if offset != pad_start:
            total_stream_padding += offset - pad_start
            if offset >= len(data):
                break
        if offset + 6 > len(data):
            remaining = data[offset:]
            if len(remaining) == 0:
                break
            if all(b == 0 for b in remaining):
                total_stream_padding += len(remaining)
                break
            raise ValueError("truncated")
        if data[offset:offset+6] != b'\xfd7zXZ\x00':
            raise ValueError("File format not recognized")
        header = data[offset:offset+12]
        check_type_id = header[7] & 0x0F
        check_size_map = {0:0, 1:4, 4:8, 10:32}
        check_size = check_size_map.get(check_type_id, 0)
        check_name_map = {0:"None", 1:"CRC32", 4:"CRC64", 10:"SHA256"}
        check_name = check_name_map.get(check_type_id, f"Unknown-{check_type_id}")
        candidate = None
        for f_start, idx_start, real in footers:
            if f_start > offset and idx_start >= offset+12:
                candidate = (f_start, idx_start, real)
                break
        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError("File format not recognized")
        f_start, idx_start, backward_real = candidate
        pos = idx_start
        if data[pos] != 0:
            raise ValueError("index indicator")
        pos += 1
        num_records, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
        records = []
        for _ in range(num_records):
            unpadded, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
            uncomp, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
            records.append((unpadded, uncomp))
        idx_data_len = pos - idx_start
        pad_len = (4 - ((idx_data_len + 4) % 4)) % 4
        pos += pad_len + 4
        blocks = []
        block_offset = offset + 12
        uncomp_offset_stream = 0
        for unpadded, uncomp in records:
            if block_offset + 1 > len(data):
                raise ValueError("block truncated")
            hdr_size_enc = data[block_offset]
            hdr_size = (hdr_size_enc + 1) * 4
            if block_offset + hdr_size > len(data):
                raise ValueError("block header overflow")
            bh = data[block_offset:block_offset+hdr_size]
            bflags = bh[1]
            has_comp = (bflags & 0x40) != 0
            has_uncomp = (bflags & 0x80) != 0
            p = 2
            comp_size = None
            if has_comp:
                comp_size, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
            if has_uncomp:
                _, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
            num_filters = (bflags & 0x03) + 1
            filter_descs = []
            for _ in range(num_filters):
                if p >= len(bh):
                    break
                fid, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
                fsize, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
                fprops = bh[p:p+fsize] if fsize>0 else b''
                p += fsize
                if fid == 0x21:
                    if fsize == 1 and fprops:
                        bits = fprops[0] & 0x3F
                        mant = 2 if bits%2==0 else 3
                        exp = 11 + bits//2
                        size = mant * (1 << exp)
                        if size >= 1024*1024:
                            ds = f"{size//(1024*1024)}MiB" if size%(1024*1024)==0 else f"{size}B"
                        elif size >= 1024:
                            ds = f"{size//1024}KiB"
                        else:
                            ds = f"{size}B"
                        filter_descs.append(f"--lzma2=dict={ds}")
                    else:
                        filter_descs.append("--lzma2=dict=8MiB")
                else:
                    filter_descs.append("--lzma2=dict=8MiB")
            if comp_size is None:
                comp_size = unpadded - hdr_size - check_size
            padded_comp = (comp_size + 3) & ~3
            total_block_size = hdr_size + padded_comp + check_size
            flags_str = ""
            if has_comp:
                flags_str += "c"
            if has_uncomp:
                flags_str += "u"
            if flags_str == "":
                flags_str = "--"
            comp_data_offset = block_offset + hdr_size
            check_offset = comp_data_offset + padded_comp
            check_val = data[check_offset:check_offset+check_size]
            if check_size in (4,8):
                check_val_display = check_val[::-1].hex()
            else:
                check_val_display = check_val.hex()
            blocks.append({
                'header_size': hdr_size,
                'comp_size': comp_size,
                'unpadded': unpadded,
                'uncomp': uncomp,
                'total_size': total_block_size,
                'comp_offset': block_offset,
                'uncomp_offset': uncomp_offset_stream,
                'check_val_hex': check_val_display,
                'filter_str': ",".join(filter_descs) if filter_descs else "--lzma2=dict=8MiB",
                'flags_str': flags_str,
            })
            uncomp_offset_stream += uncomp
            block_offset += total_block_size
        comp_size_stream = f_start + 12 - offset
        uncomp_size_stream = sum(r[1] for r in records)
        streams.append({
            'blocks': blocks,
            'comp_offset': offset,
            'uncomp_offset': total_uncomp,
            'comp_size': comp_size_stream,
            'uncomp_size': uncomp_size_stream,
            'check_name': check_name,
        })
        total_uncomp += uncomp_size_stream
        offset = f_start + 12
    return {
        'streams': streams,
        'file_size': file_size,
        'total_blocks': sum(len(s['blocks']) for s in streams),
        'total_streams': len(streams),
        'total_uncomp': total_uncomp,
        'total_stream_padding': total_stream_padding,
        'check_name': streams[0]['check_name'] if streams else "None",
    }

def format_size_l(size):
    if size < 10*1024:
        return f"{size} B"
    if size < 1024*1024:
        return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
    if size < 1024*1024*1024:
        return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
    return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def format_ratio(comp, uncomp):
    if uncomp == 0:
        return "---"
    r = comp / uncomp
    if r > 9.999:
        return "---"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def format_ratio_verbose(comp, uncomp):
    if uncomp == 0:
        return "---"
    r = comp / uncomp
    if r > 9.999:
        return "> 9.999"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def parse_size_str(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if s.endswith('%'):
        return s
    for suf, mult in [("GiB",1024**3), ("MiB",1024**2), ("KiB",1024)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num = float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    for suf, mult in [("G",10**9), ("M",10**6), ("K",10**3)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num = float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    try:
        return int(s)
    except:
        return s

def get_default_settings():
    prog = os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]).lower()
    base = prog
    default_op = "compress"
    default_stdout = False
    default_format = "xz"
    if base == "xzcat" or base.endswith("xzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "auto"
    elif base == "unxz" or base.endswith("unxz"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "auto"
    elif base == "lzcat" or base.endswith("lzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif base == "unlzma" or base.endswith("unlzma"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif base == "lzma" or base.endswith("/lzma") or base == "lzma":
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    else:
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "xz"
        default_stdout = False
    # Handle exact names with path
    if base == "lzma":
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    return default_op, default_stdout, default_format

def format_stream_line_lv(s_num, blocks, comp_off, uncomp_off, comp_size, uncomp_size, ratio, check, padding):
    arr=[" "]*200
    def put(start,width,val):
        sv=str(val).rjust(width)
        for i,ch in enumerate(sv):
            if start+i < len(arr):
                arr[start+i]=ch
    put(4,6,s_num)
    put(14,6,blocks)
    put(26,10,comp_off)
    put(40,12,uncomp_off)
    put(60,8,comp_size)
    put(74,10,uncomp_size)
    put(86,5,ratio)
    put(93,5,check)
    put(104,7,padding)
    return "".join(arr).rstrip()

def format_block_line_lv(s_num, b_num, comp_off, uncomp_off, total_size, uncomp_size, ratio, check):
    arr=[" "]*200
    def put(start,width,val):
        sv=str(val).rjust(width)
        for i,ch in enumerate(sv):
            arr[start+i]=ch
    put(4,6,s_num)
    put(15,5,b_num)
    put(26,10,comp_off)
    put(40,12,uncomp_off)
    put(59,9,total_size)
    put(74,10,uncomp_size)
    put(86,5,ratio)
    put(93,5,check)
    return "".join(arr).rstrip()

def format_block_line_lvv(s_num, b_num, comp_off, uncomp_off, total_size, uncomp_size, ratio, check, check_val, header_sz, flags, comp_sz, mem_usage, filter_str):
    arr=[" "]*300
    def put(start,width,val,align="right"):
        sv=str(val)
        sv=sv.rjust(width) if align=="right" else sv.ljust(width)
        for i,ch in enumerate(sv):
            if start+i < len(arr):
                arr[start+i]=ch
    put(4,6,s_num)
    put(15,5,b_num)
    put(26,10,comp_off)
    put(40,12,uncomp_off)
    put(59,9,total_size)
    put(74,10,uncomp_size)
    put(86,5,ratio)
    put(93,5,check)
    put(104,16,check_val)
    put(122,6,header_sz)
    put(130,5,flags,align="left")
    put(143,8,comp_sz)
    put(155,8,mem_usage)
    put(165, len(filter_str), filter_str, align="left")
    return "".join(arr).rstrip()

    prog = sys.argv[0]
    prog_basename = os.path.basename(prog)

    def get_known_suffixes_for_compress(fmt):
        if suffix_opt is not None:
            if fmt == "xz":
                return [suffix_opt, ".xz", ".txz"]
            elif fmt == "lzma":
                return [suffix_opt, ".lzma", ".tlz"]
            else:
                return [suffix_opt]
        else:
            if fmt == "xz":
                return [".xz", ".txz"]
            elif fmt == "lzma":
                return [".lzma", ".tlz"]
            else:
                return [".xz", ".txz"]

    def get_known_suffixes_for_decompress():
        base = [".xz", ".txz", ".lzma", ".tlz"]
        if suffix_opt is not None:
            return [suffix_opt] + base
        return base

    def check_already_has_suffix(filename, fmt):
        known = get_known_suffixes_for_compress(fmt)
        for suf in known:
            if filename.endswith(suf):
                return suf
        return None

    def strip_suffix_for_decompress(filename):
        known = get_known_suffixes_for_decompress()
        for suf in known:
            if filename.endswith(suf):
                if suf in (".txz", ".tlz"):
                    prefix = filename[:-len(suf)]
                    return prefix + ".tar", suf
                else:
                    return filename[:-len(suf)], suf
        return None, None

    def get_check_const(s):
        s = s.lower()
        if s == "none":
            return lzma.CHECK_NONE
        if s == "crc32":
            return lzma.CHECK_CRC32
        if s == "crc64":
            return lzma.CHECK_CRC64
        if s == "sha256":
            return lzma.CHECK_SHA256
        return lzma.CHECK_CRC64

    def parse_filter_opts(opt_str):
        opts = {}
        if not opt_str:
            return opts
        parts = opt_str.split(',')
        for part in parts:
            part=part.strip()
            if not part:
                continue
            if "=" in part:
                k,v = part.split("=",1)
                opts[k.strip()] = v.strip()
            else:
                opts[part] = True
        return opts

            if bname in id_map:

                else:

        if delta_options is not None:

def parse_varint(data, pos):
    val = 0
    while True:
        if pos >= len(data):
            raise ValueError("varint truncated")
        b = data[pos]
        val |= (b & 0x7F) << ( (pos - (pos//1)) *0 + 0)  # dummy to avoid shift tracking, we will use shift variable correctly below
        # Actually we need shift tracking; redo with shift
        break
    # Correct implementation
    val = 0
    shift = 0
    while True:
        if pos >= len(data):
            raise ValueError("varint truncated")
        b = data[pos]
        val |= (b & 0x7F) << shift
        pos += 1
        if (b & 0x80) == 0:
            break
        shift += 7
    return val, pos

def parse_xz_file(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    file_size = len(data)
    offset = 0
    streams = []
    total_uncomp = 0
    total_stream_padding = 0
    footers = []
    for i in range(len(data)-11):
        if data[i+10] == 0x59 and data[i+11] == 0x5A:
            try:
                bsize = struct.unpack('<I', data[i+4:i+8])[0]
                real = (bsize+1)*4
                idx_start = i - real
                if idx_start >= 0 and idx_start < len(data) and data[idx_start] == 0:
                    footers.append((i, idx_start, real))
            except:
                continue
    footers.sort()
    while offset < len(data):
        pad_start = offset
        while offset + 4 <= len(data) and data[offset:offset+4] == b'\x00\x00\x00\x00':
            offset += 4
        if offset != pad_start:
            total_stream_padding += offset - pad_start
            if offset >= len(data):
                break
        if offset + 6 > len(data):
            remaining = data[offset:]
            if len(remaining) == 0:
                break
            if all(b == 0 for b in remaining):
                total_stream_padding += len(remaining)
                break
            raise ValueError("truncated")
        if data[offset:offset+6] != b'\xfd7zXZ\x00':
            raise ValueError("File format not recognized")
        header = data[offset:offset+12]
        check_type_id = header[7] & 0x0F
        check_size_map = {0:0, 1:4, 4:8, 10:32}
        check_size = check_size_map.get(check_type_id, 0)
        check_name_map = {0:"None", 1:"CRC32", 4:"CRC64", 10:"SHA256"}
        check_name = check_name_map.get(check_type_id, f"Unknown-{check_type_id}")
        candidate = None
        for f_start, idx_start, real in footers:
            if f_start > offset and idx_start >= offset+12:
                candidate = (f_start, idx_start, real)
                break
        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError("File format not recognized")
        f_start, idx_start, backward_real = candidate
        pos = idx_start
        if data[pos] != 0:
            raise ValueError("index indicator")
        pos += 1
        num_records, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
        records = []
        for _ in range(num_records):
            unpadded, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
            uncomp, pos = parse_varint(data, pos)
            records.append((unpadded, uncomp))
        idx_data_len = pos - idx_start
        pad_len = (4 - ((idx_data_len + 4) % 4)) % 4
        pos += pad_len + 4
        blocks = []
        block_offset = offset + 12
        uncomp_offset_stream = 0
        for unpadded, uncomp in records:
            if block_offset + 1 > len(data):
                raise ValueError("block truncated")
            hdr_size_enc = data[block_offset]
            hdr_size = (hdr_size_enc + 1) * 4
            if block_offset + hdr_size > len(data):
                raise ValueError("block header overflow")
            bh = data[block_offset:block_offset+hdr_size]
            bflags = bh[1]
            has_comp = (bflags & 0x40) != 0
            has_uncomp = (bflags & 0x80) != 0
            p = 2
            comp_size = None
            if has_comp:
                comp_size, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
            if has_uncomp:
                _, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
            num_filters = (bflags & 0x03) + 1
            filter_descs = []
            for _ in range(num_filters):
                if p >= len(bh):
                    break
                fid, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
                fsize, p = parse_varint(bh, p)
                fprops = bh[p:p+fsize] if fsize>0 else b''
                p += fsize
                if fid == 0x21:
                    if fsize == 1 and fprops:
                        bits = fprops[0] & 0x3F
                        mant = 2 if bits%2==0 else 3
                        exp = 11 + bits//2
                        size = mant * (1 << exp)
                        if size >= 1024*1024:
                            ds = f"{size//(1024*1024)}MiB" if size%(1024*1024)==0 else f"{size}B"
                        elif size >= 1024:
                            ds = f"{size//1024}KiB"
                        else:
                            ds = f"{size}B"
                        filter_descs.append(f"--lzma2=dict={ds}")
                    else:
                        filter_descs.append("--lzma2=dict=8MiB")
                else:
                    filter_descs.append("--lzma2=dict=8MiB")
            if comp_size is None:
                comp_size = unpadded - hdr_size - check_size
            padded_comp = (comp_size + 3) & ~3
            total_block_size = hdr_size + padded_comp + check_size
            flags_str = ""
            if has_comp:
                flags_str += "c"
            if has_uncomp:
                flags_str += "u"
            if flags_str == "":
                flags_str = "--"
            comp_data_offset = block_offset + hdr_size
            check_offset = comp_data_offset + padded_comp
            check_val = data[check_offset:check_offset+check_size]
            if check_size in (4,8):
                check_val_display = check_val[::-1].hex()
            else:
                check_val_display = check_val.hex()
            blocks.append({
                'header_size': hdr_size,
                'comp_size': comp_size,
                'unpadded': unpadded,
                'uncomp': uncomp,
                'total_size': total_block_size,
                'comp_offset': block_offset,
                'uncomp_offset': uncomp_offset_stream,
                'check_val_hex': check_val_display,
                'filter_str': ",".join(filter_descs) if filter_descs else "--lzma2=dict=8MiB",
                'flags_str': flags_str,
            })
            uncomp_offset_stream += uncomp
            block_offset += total_block_size
        comp_size_stream = f_start + 12 - offset
        uncomp_size_stream = sum(r[1] for r in records)
        streams.append({
            'blocks': blocks,
            'comp_offset': offset,
            'uncomp_offset': total_uncomp,
            'comp_size': comp_size_stream,
            'uncomp_size': uncomp_size_stream,
            'check_name': check_name,
        })
        total_uncomp += uncomp_size_stream
        offset = f_start + 12
    return {
        'streams': streams,
        'file_size': file_size,
        'total_blocks': sum(len(s['blocks']) for s in streams),
        'total_streams': len(streams),
        'total_uncomp': total_uncomp,
        'total_stream_padding': total_stream_padding,
        'check_name': streams[0]['check_name'] if streams else "None",
    }

def format_size_l(size):
    if size < 10*1024:
        return f"{size} B"
    if size < 1024*1024:
        return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
    if size < 1024*1024*1024:
        return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
    return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def format_ratio(comp, uncomp):
    if uncomp == 0:
        return "---"
    r = comp / uncomp
    if r > 9.999:
        return "---"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def format_ratio_verbose(comp, uncomp):
    if uncomp == 0:
        return "---"
    r = comp / uncomp
    if r > 9.999:
        return "> 9.999"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def parse_size_str(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if s.endswith('%'):
        return s
    for suf, mult in [("GiB",1024**3), ("MiB",1024**2), ("KiB",1024)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num = float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    for suf, mult in [("G",10**9), ("M",10**6), ("K",10**3)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num = float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    try:
        return int(s)
    except:
        return s

def get_default_settings():
    prog = os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]).lower()
    base = prog
    default_op = "compress"
    default_stdout = False
    default_format = "xz"
    if base == "xzcat" or base.endswith("xzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "auto"
    elif base == "unxz" or base.endswith("unxz"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "auto"
    elif base == "lzcat" or base.endswith("lzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif base == "unlzma" or base.endswith("unlzma"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif base == "lzma" or base.endswith("/lzma") or base == "lzma":
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    else:
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "xz"
        default_stdout = False
    # Handle exact names with path
    if base == "lzma":
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    return default_op, default_stdout, default_format

def format_stream_line_lv(s_num, blocks, comp_off, uncomp_off, comp_size, uncomp_size, ratio, check, padding):
    arr=[" "]*200
    def put(start,width,val):
        sv=str(val).rjust(width)
        for i,ch in enumerate(sv):
            if start+i < len(arr):
                arr[start+i]=ch
    put(4,6,s_num)
    put(14,6,blocks)
    put(26,10,comp_off)
    put(40,12,uncomp_off)
    put(60,8,comp_size)
    put(74,10,uncomp_size)
    put(86,5,ratio)
    put(93,5,check)
    put(104,7,padding)
    return "".join(arr).rstrip()

def format_block_line_lv(s_num, b_num, comp_off, uncomp_off, total_size, uncomp_size, ratio, check):
    arr=[" "]*200
    def put(start,width,val):
        sv=str(val).rjust(width)
        for i,ch in enumerate(sv):
            arr[start+i]=ch
    put(4,6,s_num)
    put(15,5,b_num)
    put(26,10,comp_off)
    put(40,12,uncomp_off)
    put(59,9,total_size)
    put(74,10,uncomp_size)
    put(86,5,ratio)
    put(93,5,check)
    return "".join(arr).rstrip()

def format_block_line_lvv(s_num, b_num, comp_off, uncomp_off, total_size, uncomp_size, ratio, check, check_val, header_sz, flags, comp_sz, mem_usage, filter_str):
    arr=[" "]*300
    def put(start,width,val,align="right"):
        sv=str(val)
        sv=sv.rjust(width) if align=="right" else sv.ljust(width)
        for i,ch in enumerate(sv):
            if start+i < len(arr):
                arr[start+i]=ch
    put(4,6,s_num)
    put(15,5,b_num)
    put(26,10,comp_off)
    put(40,12,uncomp_off)
    put(59,9,total_size)
    put(74,10,uncomp_size)
    put(86,5,ratio)
    put(93,5,check)
    put(104,16,check_val)
    put(122,6,header_sz)
    put(130,5,flags,align="left")
    put(143,8,comp_sz)
    put(155,8,mem_usage)
    put(165, len(filter_str), filter_str, align="left")
    return "".join(arr).rstrip()

def main():
    prog = sys.argv[0]
    prog_basename = os.path.basename(prog)
    prog_for_help = prog
    default_op, default_stdout, default_format = get_default_settings()
    env_opts = []
    for env_var in ["XZ_DEFAULTS", "XZ_OPT"]:
        val = os.environ.get(env_var)
        if val:
            try:
                env_opts.extend(shlex.split(val))
            except:
                env_opts.extend(val.split())
    raw_args = env_opts + sys.argv[1:]

    operation = None
    keep = False
    force = False
    stdout_flag = default_stdout
    suffix_opt = None
    format_opt = None
    check_opt = "crc64"
    preset = 6
    extreme = False
    quiet = 0
    verbose = 0
    no_warn = False
    robot = False
    single_stream = False
    custom_filters = {}
    bcj_filters = []
    delta_options = None
    files = []
    files_from = []

    i = 0
    end_of_options = False
    while i < len(raw_args):
        arg = raw_args[i]
        if end_of_options:
            files.append(arg)
            i+=1
            continue
        if arg == "--":
            end_of_options = True
            i+=1
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--"):
            if "=" in arg:
                key, val = arg.split("=",1)
            else:
                key, val = arg, None
            if key == "--compress":
                operation = "compress"
            elif key == "--decompress":
                operation = "decompress"
            elif key == "--test":
                operation = "test"
            elif key == "--list":
                operation = "list"
            elif key == "--keep":
                keep = True
            elif key == "--force":
                force = True
            elif key in ("--stdout","--to-stdout"):
                stdout_flag = True
            elif key in ("--no-sync","--no-sparse"):
                pass
            elif key == "--single-stream":
                single_stream = True
            elif key == "--suffix":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    suffix_opt = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else None
                else:
                    suffix_opt = val
            elif key.startswith("--suffix="):
                suffix_opt = val
            elif key == "--files":
                if val is None:
                    files_from.append((None, False))
                else:
                    files_from.append((val, False))
            elif key.startswith("--files="):
                files_from.append((val, False))
            elif key == "--files0":
                if val is None:
                    files_from.append((None, True))
                else:
                    files_from.append((val, True))
            elif key.startswith("--files0="):
                files_from.append((val, True))
            elif key == "--format":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    format_opt = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else None
                else:
                    format_opt = val
            elif key.startswith("--format="):
                format_opt = val
            elif key == "--check":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    check_opt = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else "crc64"
                else:
                    check_opt = val
            elif key.startswith("--check="):
                check_opt = val
            elif key == "--ignore-check":
                pass
            elif key == "--threads":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    val = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else None
            elif key.startswith("--threads="):
                pass
            elif key.startswith("--block-size") or key.startswith("--block-list") or key.startswith("--flush-timeout") or key.startswith("--memlimit"):
                pass
            elif key == "--no-adjust":
                pass
            elif key == "--filters":
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    custom_filters["filters"] = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else ""
                else:
                    custom_filters["filters"] = val
            elif key.startswith("--filters="):
                custom_filters["filters"] = val
            elif key.startswith("--filters") and len(key)>9 and key[9:].isdigit():
                if val is None:
                    i+=1
                    custom_filters[key[2:]] = raw_args[i] if i < len(raw_args) else ""
                else:
                    custom_filters[key[2:]] = val
            elif key == "--filters-help":
                sys.stdout.write(FILTERS_HELP_TEXT)
                sys.exit(0)
            elif key.startswith("--lzma1"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                custom_filters["lzma1"] = opt
            elif key.startswith("--lzma2"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                custom_filters["lzma2"] = opt
            elif key.startswith("--x86"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("x86", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--armthumb"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("armthumb", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--arm64"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("arm64", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--arm"):
                if key == "--arm" or key.startswith("--arm="):
                    opt = val if val is not None else ""
                    bcj_filters.append(("arm", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--powerpc"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("powerpc", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--ia64"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("ia64", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--sparc"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("sparc", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--riscv"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                bcj_filters.append(("riscv", opt))
            elif key.startswith("--delta"):
                opt = val if val is not None else ""
                delta_options = opt
            elif key == "--quiet":
                quiet += 1
            elif key == "--verbose":
                verbose += 1
            elif key == "--no-warn":
                no_warn = True
            elif key == "--robot":
                robot = True
            elif key == "--info-memory":
                sys.stdout.write(INFO_MEMORY_TEXT)
                sys.exit(0)
            elif key == "--help":
                sys.stdout.write(short_help(prog_for_help))
                sys.exit(0)
            elif key == "--long-help":
                sys.stdout.write(long_help(prog_for_help))
                sys.exit(0)
            elif key == "--version":
                sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT)
                sys.exit(0)
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: unrecognized option '{key}'\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"Try '{prog_basename} --help' for more information.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            i+=1
            continue
        if arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            import re
            m = re.match(r'^-([0-9])(e)?(.*)$', arg)
            if m:
                preset = int(m.group(1))
                if m.group(2):
                    extreme = True
                rest = m.group(3)
                for ch in rest:
                    if ch == 'e':
                        extreme = True
                    elif ch == 'k':
                        keep = True
                    elif ch == 'f':
                        force = True
                    elif ch == 'c':
                        stdout_flag = True
                    elif ch == 'q':
                        quiet +=1
                    elif ch == 'v':
                        verbose +=1
                    elif ch == 'Q':
                        no_warn = True
                    elif ch == 'z':
                        operation = "compress"
                    elif ch == 'd':
                        operation = "decompress"
                    elif ch == 't':
                        operation = "test"
                    elif ch == 'l':
                        operation = "list"
                    else:
                        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: invalid option -- '{ch}'\n")
                        sys.exit(1)
                i+=1
                continue
            j = 1
            while j < len(arg):
                ch = arg[j]
                if ch == 'z':
                    operation = "compress"
                elif ch == 'd':
                    operation = "decompress"
                elif ch == 't':
                    operation = "test"
                elif ch == 'l':
                    operation = "list"
                elif ch == 'k':
                    keep = True
                elif ch == 'f':
                    force = True
                elif ch == 'c':
                    stdout_flag = True
                elif ch == 'q':
                    quiet +=1
                elif ch == 'v':
                    verbose +=1
                elif ch == 'Q':
                    no_warn = True
                elif ch == 'h':
                    sys.stdout.write(short_help(prog_for_help))
                    sys.exit(0)
                elif ch == 'H':
                    sys.stdout.write(long_help(prog_for_help))
                    sys.exit(0)
                elif ch == 'V':
                    sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT)
                    sys.exit(0)
                elif ch == 'e':
                    extreme = True
                elif ch in ('T','S','F','C','M'):
                    remaining = arg[j+1:]
                    if remaining:
                        val = remaining
                        j = len(arg)
                        if ch == 'S':
                            suffix_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'F':
                            format_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'C':
                            check_opt = val
                        break
                    else:
                        i+=1
                        if i >= len(raw_args):
                            sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: option requires an argument -- '{ch}'\n")
                            sys.exit(1)
                        val = raw_args[i]
                        if ch == 'S':
                            suffix_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'F':
                            format_opt = val
                        elif ch == 'C':
                            check_opt = val
                        break
                else:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: invalid option -- '{ch}'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write(f"Try '{prog_basename} --help' for more information.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                j+=1
            i+=1
            continue
        files.append(arg)
        i+=1

    if operation is None:
        operation = default_op

    if format_opt is None:
        if operation in ("decompress","test","list"):
            prog_lower = os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]).lower()
            if "lzma" in prog_lower and "xz" not in prog_lower:
                format_opt = "lzma"
            else:
                if default_format == "lzma":
                    format_opt = "lzma"
                else:
                    format_opt = "auto"
        else:
            format_opt = default_format

    format_opt = format_opt.lower()
    if format_opt not in ("auto","xz","lzma","lzip","raw"):
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: --format={format_opt}: Unknown file format type\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    if operation == "compress" and format_opt == "lzip":
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: Compression of lzip files (.lz) is not supported\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    if robot and operation in ("compress","decompress","test"):
        sys.stderr.write(f"{prog_basename}: Compression and decompression with --robot are not supported yet.\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    if operation == "list":

    def get_known_suffixes_for_compress(fmt):
        if suffix_opt is not None:
            if fmt == "xz":
                return [suffix_opt, ".xz", ".txz"]
            elif fmt == "lzma":
                return [suffix_opt, ".lzma", ".tlz"]
            else:
                return [suffix_opt]
        else:
            if fmt == "xz":
                return [".xz", ".txz"]
            elif fmt == "lzma":
                return [".lzma", ".tlz"]
            else:
                return [".xz", ".txz"]

    def get_known_suffixes_for_decompress():
        base = [".xz", ".txz", ".lzma", ".tlz"]
        if suffix_opt is not None:
            return [suffix_opt] + base
        return base

    def check_already_has_suffix(filename, fmt):
        known = get_known_suffixes_for_compress(fmt)
        for suf in known:
            if filename.endswith(suf):
                return suf
        return None

    def strip_suffix_for_decompress(filename):
        known = get_known_suffixes_for_decompress()
        for suf in known:
            if filename.endswith(suf):
                if suf in (".txz", ".tlz"):
                    prefix = filename[:-len(suf)]
                    return prefix + ".tar", suf
                else:
                    return filename[:-len(suf)], suf
        return None, None

    def get_check_const(s):
        s = s.lower()
        if s == "none":
            return lzma.CHECK_NONE
        if s == "crc32":
            return lzma.CHECK_CRC32
        if s == "crc64":
            return lzma.CHECK_CRC64
        if s == "sha256":
            return lzma.CHECK_SHA256
        return lzma.CHECK_CRC64

    def parse_filter_opts(opt_str):
        opts = {}
        if not opt_str:
            return opts
        parts = opt_str.split(',')
        for part in parts:
            part=part.strip()
            if not part:
                continue
            if "=" in part:
                k,v = part.split("=",1)
                opts[k.strip()] = v.strip()
            else:
                opts[part] = True
        return opts

                else:

        if delta_options is not None:

        if format_opt == "xz" and use_lzma1:

                except:

            else:

                except:
                    pass

        fd = {"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA1 if use_lzma1 else lzma.FILTER_LZMA2}
        pv = lz_preset | (lzma.PRESET_EXTREME if lz_extreme else 0)
        fd["preset"] = pv
        if "dict" in lopts:

        if "lc" in lopts:

                pass
        if "lp" in lopts:

                fd["lp"] = int(lopts["lp"])
            except:
                pass
        if "pb" in lopts:

            except:
                pass
        if "mode" in lopts:

        if "nice" in lopts:

        if "depth" in lopts:

            except:

        chain.append(fd)

def parse_varint(data, pos):
    val=0
    shift=0
    while True:
        if pos>=len(data):
            raise ValueError("varint truncated")
        b=data[pos]
        val|=(b&0x7F)<<shift
        pos+=1
        if (b&0x80)==0:
            break
        shift+=7
    return val,pos

def parse_varint_encode(v):
    out=[]
    while True:
        b=v&0x7F
        v>>=7
        if v!=0:
            out.append(b|0x80)
        else:
            out.append(b)
            break
    return bytes(out)

def crc32_py(d):
    return binascii.crc32(d) & 0xffffffff

POLY_REF=0xC96C5795D7870F42
_table_ref=[]

    for _ in range(8):

            c=(c>>1)^POLY_REF
        else:
            c>>=1
    _table_ref.append(c & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)

def crc64_py(d):
    crc=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    for b in d:
        idx=(crc ^ b) & 0xFF
        crc=_table_ref[idx] ^ (crc>>8)
    return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

                comp_size=up - hdr_size - check_size
            padded=(comp_size+3)&~3
            total_block=hdr_size+padded+check_size
            flags_str=""
            if has_comp:
                flags_str+="c"
            if has_uncomp:
                flags_str+="u"
            if flags_str=="":
                flags_str="--"
            comp_data_off=block_offset+hdr_size
            check_off=comp_data_off+padded
            check_val=data[check_off:check_off+check_size]
            if check_size in (4,8):
                check_disp=check_val[::-1].hex()
            else:
                check_disp=check_val.hex()
            blocks.append({
                'header_size':hdr_size,
                'comp_size':comp_size,
                'unpadded':up,
                'uncomp':uc,
                'total_size':total_block,
                'comp_offset':block_offset,
                'uncomp_offset':uncomp_off_stream,
                'check_val_hex':check_disp,
                'filter_str':",".join(filter_descs) if filter_descs else "--lzma2=dict=8MiB",
                'flags_str':flags_str,
            })
            uncomp_off_stream+=uc
            block_offset+=total_block
        comp_stream=f_start+12-offset
        uncomp_stream=sum(r[1] for r in records)
        streams.append({
            'blocks':blocks,
            'comp_offset':offset,
            'uncomp_offset':total_uncomp,
            'comp_size':comp_stream,
            'uncomp_size':uncomp_stream,
            'check_name':check_name,
        })
        total_uncomp+=uncomp_stream
        offset=f_start+12
    return {
        'streams':streams,
        'file_size':file_size,
        'total_blocks':sum(len(s['blocks']) for s in streams),
        'total_streams':len(streams),
        'total_uncomp':total_uncomp,
        'total_stream_padding':total_padding,
        'check_name':streams[0]['check_name'] if streams else "None",
    }

def format_size_l(size):
    if size < 10*1024:
        return f"{size} B"
    if size < 1024*1024:
        return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
    if size < 1024*1024*1024:
        return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
    return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def format_ratio(comp,uncomp):
    if uncomp==0:
        return "---"
    r=comp/uncomp
    if r>9.999:
        return "---"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def format_ratio_verbose(comp,uncomp):
    if uncomp==0:
        return "---"
    r=comp/uncomp
    if r>9.999:
        return "> 9.999"
    return f"{r:.3f}"

def parse_size_str(s):
    s=s.strip()
    if s.endswith('%'):
        return s
    for suf,mult in [("GiB",1024**3),("MiB",1024**2),("KiB",1024)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num=float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    for suf,mult in [("G",10**9),("M",10**6),("K",10**3)]:
        if s.endswith(suf):
            try:
                num=float(s[:-len(suf)])
                return int(num*mult)
            except:
                pass
    try:
        return int(s)
    except:
        return s

def build_xz(data, comp_data, check_type=4, has_sizes=True, header_size_desired=None, dict_byte=0x16):
    check_size_map={0:0,1:4,4:8,10:32}
    check_size=check_size_map.get(check_type,0)
    if check_type==0:
        check_bytes=b""
    elif check_type==1:
        check_bytes=struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(data))
    elif check_type==4:
        check_bytes=struct.pack('<Q', crc64_py(data))
    else:
        check_bytes=hashlib.sha256(data).digest()

    stream_header=b'\xFD7zXZ\x00'
    flags=struct.pack('<H', check_type<<8)
    stream_header+=flags+struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(flags))

    filter_id=0x21
    props=bytes([dict_byte])
    filter_flags=parse_varint_encode(filter_id)+parse_varint_encode(len(props))+props

    bflags=0
    if has_sizes:
        bflags|=0x40|0x80

    bh_body=struct.pack('B', bflags)
    if has_sizes:
        bh_body+=parse_varint_encode(len(comp_data))
        bh_body+=parse_varint_encode(len(data))
    bh_body+=filter_flags

    if header_size_desired is None:
        total=len(bh_body)+1+4
        pad=(4-(total%4))%4
        real=total+pad
    else:
        real=header_size_desired
        total_without_pad=len(bh_body)+1+4
        pad=real-total_without_pad
        if pad<0:
            # need larger
            real=total_without_pad
            pad=(4-(real%4))%4
            real+=pad

    size_byte=(real//4 -1) & 0xFF
    header_without_crc=struct.pack('B', size_byte)+bh_body+b'\x00'*pad
    block_header=header_without_crc+struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(header_without_crc))

    comp_padded=comp_data + b'\x00'* ((4 - (len(comp_data)%4))%4)
    block=block_header+comp_padded+check_bytes

    unpadded=len(block_header)+len(comp_data)+len(check_bytes)
    idx_body=b'\x00'+parse_varint_encode(1)+parse_varint_encode(unpadded)+parse_varint_encode(len(data))
    total_idx=len(idx_body)+4
    pad_idx=(4-(total_idx%4))%4
    idx_body_padded=idx_body+b'\x00'*pad_idx
    index=idx_body_padded+struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(idx_body_padded))

    backward=len(index)//4 -1
    footer_body=struct.pack('<I', backward)+flags
    footer=struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(footer_body))+footer_body+b'YZ'

    return stream_header+block+index+footer

def build_xz_multi(chunks, check_type=4, has_sizes=True, header_sizes=None, dict_byte=0x16):
    check_size_map={0:0,1:4,4:8,10:32}
    check_size=check_size_map.get(check_type,0)
    stream_header=b'\xFD7zXZ\x00'
    flags=struct.pack('<H', check_type<<8)
    stream_header+=flags+struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(flags))

    blocks=[]
    for idx, (data, comp_data) in enumerate(chunks):
        if check_type==0:
            check_bytes=b""
        elif check_type==1:
            check_bytes=struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(data))
        elif check_type==4:
            check_bytes=struct.pack('<Q', crc64_py(data))
        else:
            check_bytes=hashlib.sha256(data).digest()

        filter_id=0x21
        props=bytes([dict_byte])
        filter_flags=parse_varint_encode(filter_id)+parse_varint_encode(len(props))+props

        bflags=0
        if has_sizes:
            bflags|=0x40|0x80
        bh_body=struct.pack('B', bflags)
        if has_sizes:
            bh_body+=parse_varint_encode(len(comp_data))
            bh_body+=parse_varint_encode(len(data))
        bh_body+=filter_flags

        if header_sizes and idx < len(header_sizes):
            real=header_sizes[idx]
            total_without_pad=len(bh_body)+1+4
            pad=real-total_without_pad
            if pad<0:
                real=total_without_pad
                pad=(4-(real%4))%4
                real+=pad
        else:
            total=len(bh_body)+1+4
            pad=(4-(total%4))%4
            real=total+pad

        size_byte=(real//4 -1) & 0xFF
        header_without_crc=struct.pack('B', size_byte)+bh_body+b'\x00'*pad
        block_header=header_without_crc+struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(header_without_crc))

        comp_padded=comp_data + b'\x00'* ((4 - (len(comp_data)%4))%4)
        block=block_header+comp_padded+check_bytes
        blocks.append((block, len(block_header)+len(comp_data)+len(check_bytes), data))

    unpaddeds=[b[1] for b in blocks]
    uncomps=[len(b[2]) for b in blocks]
    idx_body=b'\x00'+parse_varint_encode(len(blocks))
    for up,uc in zip(unpaddeds, uncomps):
        idx_body+=parse_varint_encode(up)+parse_varint_encode(uc)
    total_idx=len(idx_body)+4
    pad_idx=(4-(total_idx%4))%4
    idx_body_padded=idx_body+b'\x00'*pad_idx
    index=idx_body_padded+struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(idx_body_padded))

    backward=len(index)//4 -1
    footer_body=struct.pack('<I', backward)+flags
    footer=struct.pack('<I', crc32_py(footer_body))+footer_body+b'YZ'

    full=stream_header
    for b,_,_ in blocks:
        full+=b
    full+=index+footer
    return full

def get_default_settings():
    prog = os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]).lower()
    base = prog
    default_op = "compress"
    default_stdout = False
    default_format = "xz"
    if base == "xzcat" or base.endswith("xzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "auto"
    elif base == "unxz" or base.endswith("unxz"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "auto"
    elif base == "lzcat" or base.endswith("lzcat"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_stdout = True
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif base == "unlzma" or base.endswith("unlzma"):
        default_op = "decompress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    elif base == "lzma" or base.endswith("/lzma") or base == "lzma":
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    else:
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "xz"
    if base == "lzma":
        default_op = "compress"
        default_format = "lzma"
    return default_op, default_stdout, default_format

    prog = sys.argv[0]

        val = os.environ.get(env_var)
        if val:
            try:
                env_opts.extend(shlex.split(val))
            except:
                env_opts.extend(val.split())
